import csv
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("/work/data.csv")))
xs = [r["x"] for r in rows]
ys = [float(r["y"]) for r in rows]
plt.figure()
plt.plot(xs, ys)
plt.savefig("/out/chart.png")
print(f"charted {len(rows)} rows")
